<!--
Say where to go and how we'll know we arrived. Trust the implementer to find
the code: they read the repo fresh, and anything you learned by reading it
they will re-learn in minutes. A file tour, by contrast, goes stale in days.
Name a module or a function when you must; never a line number.

Target: the whole issue fits on one screen. Delete any section you don't need.
-->

One or two paragraphs: what changes, for whom, and why now. Written for the
person who plays the game or maintains it, not as a walkthrough of the code.
Link the umbrella or sibling issue here if there is one.

## Done when

<!-- Checkable by someone who didn't write the code: a behaviour, a command
     that passes, a thing seen in the browser. `mise run ci` green is assumed
     and needn't be listed. -->

-

<!-- What a reasonable implementer might fold in, and shouldn't. Name the

## Worth knowing

<!-- Only what the implementer can't rediscover, or would get wrong:
       - a constraint that isn't visible from the code: a shared link that
         must keep working, a number others compare against, a contract
       - a trap: the obvious approach, and why it fails
       - a decision deliberately left open, named in one line
     If a fact doesn't fit one of those three, leave it out. -->
